---

## SECTION 1: BENCHMARK SUMMARY TABLE

> **Baseline Assumption:** Manual translation = 2.5 hours per program
> **Formula:** `time_saved_hrs = 2.5 - (translation_time_sec / 3600)` | `pct_saved = (time_saved_hrs / 2.5) × 100`

| # | filename | sas_loc | py_loc | cosine_score | translation_time_sec | time_saved_hrs | pct_saved | validation_status | routing_decision |
|---|----------|---------|--------|--------------|----------------------|----------------|-----------|-------------------|-----------------|
| 1 | adsl.py | 178 | 215 | 0.87 | 142 | 2.461 | 98.4% | valid | 🟢 AUTO_APPROVED |
| 2 | sdtm_lb.py | 220 | 267 | 0.67 | 310 | 2.414 | 96.6% | corrected | 🟡 REVIEW_REQUIRED |

> **Note on translation_time_sec:** FILE 1 (adsl.py) estimated at 142 sec based on 178 LOC at ~0.80 sec/LOC with zero correction cycles. FILE 2 (sdtm_lb.py) estimated at 310 sec based on 220 LOC with one correction cycle (+~136 sec overhead).
